:::{#sol-subspace-sum-practice}

Here $a\,(1, 0, 1) + b\,(0, 1, 1) = (a, b, a + b)$,
whose first two entries give $a = 2$ and $b = 3$,
and then the third entry is $2 + 3 = 5$.
So $(2, 3, 5) = 2\,(1, 0, 1) + 3\,(0, 1, 1)$,
with $2\,(1, 0, 1) \in \mathcal{S}_1$ and $3\,(0, 1, 1) \in \mathcal{S}_2$,
and $(2, 3, 5)$ is in $\mathcal{S}_1 + \mathcal{S}_2$.

:::
